reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Connecticut
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Is it unlawful to evict a tenant because of the type of income they receive,
    their status with regard to public assistance, or because they have a housing voucher?
*/

/* =========================
   Basic domain vocabulary
   ========================= */

state(connecticut).
focus_year(2021).

/* Parties and dwelling */
person(landlord1).
person(tenant1).
dwelling(dwelling1).

/* Relationship */
landlord_of(landlord1, dwelling1).
tenant_of(tenant1, dwelling1).

/* Action: eviction */
action(evict1).
action_type(evict1, eviction).
actor(evict1, landlord1).
target_person(evict1, tenant1).
target_dwelling(evict1, dwelling1).

/* Reasons asserted in the question (encoded as facts) */
eviction_reason(evict1, type_of_income).
eviction_reason(evict1, public_assistance_status).
eviction_reason(evict1, housing_voucher).

/* Facts to avoid statutory exception "solely on the basis of insufficient income"
   (CT Gen Stat  46a-64c(b)(5)) */
tenant_has_sufficient_income(tenant1).

/* Facts to avoid owner-occupied small-building exemptions in  46a-64c(b)(1)
   (We encode that this dwelling is NOT within those exemptions.) */
not_owner_occupied_exempt(dwelling1).

/* =========================
   Scenario helper predicate
   ========================= */

scenario_statement :-
    state(connecticut),
    focus_year(2021),
    person(landlord1),
    person(tenant1),
    dwelling(dwelling1),
    landlord_of(landlord1, dwelling1),
    tenant_of(tenant1, dwelling1),
    action(evict1),
    action_type(evict1, eviction),
    actor(evict1, landlord1),
    target_person(evict1, tenant1),
    target_dwelling(evict1, dwelling1),
    eviction_reason(evict1, type_of_income),
    eviction_reason(evict1, public_assistance_status),
    eviction_reason(evict1, housing_voucher),
    tenant_has_sufficient_income(tenant1),
    not_owner_occupied_exempt(dwelling1).

/* =========================
   Statute translations
   ========================= */

/* --- CT Gen Stat  46a-64c (2020): Protected classes/bases (subset used + full list) --- */
protected_basis_46a_64c(race).
protected_basis_46a_64c(creed).
protected_basis_46a_64c(color).
protected_basis_46a_64c(national_origin).
protected_basis_46a_64c(ancestry).
protected_basis_46a_64c(sex).
protected_basis_46a_64c(gender_identity_or_expression).
protected_basis_46a_64c(marital_status).
protected_basis_46a_64c(age).
protected_basis_46a_64c(lawful_source_of_income).
protected_basis_46a_64c(familial_status).
protected_basis_46a_64c(status_as_a_veteran).
protected_basis_46a_64c(learning_disability).
protected_basis_46a_64c(physical_disability).
protected_basis_46a_64c(mental_disability).

/* --- Map common "income" reasons to the statute's protected basis "lawful source of income"
   CT Gen Stat  46a-64c(a)(1)-(2) --- */
reason_maps_to_basis(type_of_income, lawful_source_of_income).
reason_maps_to_basis(public_assistance_status, lawful_source_of_income).
reason_maps_to_basis(housing_voucher, lawful_source_of_income).

/* --- CT Gen Stat  46a-64c(b)(1): Exemptions for certain owner-occupied situations.
   We encode the exemption check as a predicate; the scenario asserts it does not apply. --- */
statute_46a_64c_owner_occupied_exemption_applies(Dwelling) :-
    \+ not_owner_occupied_exempt(Dwelling).

/* --- CT Gen Stat  46a-64c(b)(5): "lawful source of income" does not prohibit denial
   solely on the basis of insufficient income. We model an exception for income-based actions. --- */
statute_46a_64c_insufficient_income_exception_applies(Person) :-
    \+ tenant_has_sufficient_income(Person).

/* --- CT Gen Stat  46a-64c(a)(2): discriminatory practice to discriminate in terms,
   conditions, or privileges of rental because of a protected basis. We treat eviction as
   affecting privileges/terms of rental (loss of tenancy). --- */
statute_46a_64c_discriminatory_practice(terms_conditions_privileges_rental, Actor, Person, Dwelling, Basis) :-
    person(Actor),
    person(Person),
    dwelling(Dwelling),
    protected_basis_46a_64c(Basis).

/* --- CT Gen Stat  46a-64c(a)(1): discriminatory practice to "otherwise make unavailable
   or deny" a dwelling because of a protected basis. We treat eviction as making the dwelling
   unavailable to the tenant. --- */
statute_46a_64c_discriminatory_practice(make_unavailable_or_deny, Actor, Person, Dwelling, Basis) :-
    person(Actor),
    person(Person),
    dwelling(Dwelling),
    protected_basis_46a_64c(Basis).

/* --- CT Gen Stat  46a-81e (2020): Sexual orientation/civil union housing discrimination.
   Not needed to answer the income/voucher question, but included as a translation of the provided statute. --- */
protected_basis_46a_81e(sexual_orientation).
protected_basis_46a_81e(civil_union_status).

statute_46a_81e_discriminatory_practice(terms_conditions_privileges_rental, Actor, Person, Dwelling, Basis) :-
    person(Actor),
    person(Person),
    dwelling(Dwelling),
    protected_basis_46a_81e(Basis).

statute_46a_81e_discriminatory_practice(make_unavailable_or_deny, Actor, Person, Dwelling, Basis) :-
    person(Actor),
    person(Person),
    dwelling(Dwelling),
    protected_basis_46a_81e(Basis).

/* =========================
   Reasoning: unlawful eviction
   ========================= */

/* Determine which protected basis the eviction is "because of" */
eviction_because_of_protected_basis(Action, Basis) :-
    action(Action),
    action_type(Action, eviction),
    eviction_reason(Action, Reason),
    reason_maps_to_basis(Reason, Basis),
    protected_basis_46a_64c(Basis).

/* Eviction constitutes "terms/conditions/privileges of rental" discrimination */
eviction_matches_statutory_conduct(terms_conditions_privileges_rental).

/* Eviction also constitutes "make unavailable or deny" */
eviction_matches_statutory_conduct(make_unavailable_or_deny).

/* Unlawful eviction under CT Gen Stat  46a-64c, subject to encoded exceptions */
unlawful_eviction_under_46a_64c(Action) :-
    action(Action),
    action_type(Action, eviction),
    actor(Action, Actor),
    target_person(Action, Person),
    target_dwelling(Action, Dwelling),
    eviction_because_of_protected_basis(Action, Basis),
    eviction_matches_statutory_conduct(Conduct),
    statute_46a_64c_discriminatory_practice(Conduct, Actor, Person, Dwelling, Basis),
    \+ statute_46a_64c_owner_occupied_exemption_applies(Dwelling),
    \+ statute_46a_64c_insufficient_income_exception_applies(Person).

/* Scenario-level query: does the encoded scenario describe an unlawful eviction? */
scenario_unlawful_eviction :-
    scenario_statement,
    unlawful_eviction_under_46a_64c(evict1).

/* =========================
   Final answer predicate
   ========================= */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_unlawful_eviction,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

/* =========================
   Main entrypoint
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it unlawful to evict a tenant because of the type of income they receive, their status with regard to public assistance, or because they have a housing voucher?
